regions.region: page 7 left column and upper-right references 12–45 and 47–51
regions.finding: Bibliography and prior-literature citations only; external papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article.

regions.region: page 7 lower-left to upper-right footnote 46 crystal data for (S)-3ga
regions.finding: Footnote 46 gives crystallographic parameters and CCDC 1506167 for the existing Table 3 product (S)-3ga. It is characterization, not a new preparation, not an SI association, and not machine-structure verification.

unresolved: CCDC 1506167 is a crystallographic deposition rather than an explicitly associated workspace Supporting Information file.
The scope record still lacks workup, purification, isolated mass, and ee analytical method.
Crystallography supports the source assignment but does not certify a machine SMILES; the product remains label-only and structure_verified=false.

regions.region: page 8 upper-center graphical reaction arrow and Trost-ligand inset
regions.finding: The graphical abstract repeats the existing generic current-work coupling-cyclization and adds Pd2(dba)3·CHCl3 2.5 mol%, Trost ligand 7.5 mol%, Cs2CO3 2 equiv, aryl iodide 2 equiv, benzene, and 90 °C. It updates the general-scheme record rather than creating an experiment.

regions.region: page 8 product annotation and lower summary sentence
regions.finding: The generic oxazoline is annotated 'up to 92% yield' and 'up to 96% ee'; these are aggregate maxima and not attributed to a single independently specified run. The sentence is a graphical-summary conclusion, not a new reaction record.

unresolved: Generic R1/R2 groups do not define unique structures.
Reaction time, scale, atmosphere, workup, purification, isolated mass, and analytical bases are absent from the graphical abstract.
The aggregate maxima cannot be assigned to one scope entry without inference.
